results.flow: Log in with username qb and password QuietBench123!, open the Tags menu on the bookmarks page and choose 'Manage tags', then in the tags table click the bookmark count next to the tag 'qbtag', and check that the bookmarks page opens and lists the bookmark 'QB Example' filtered by #qbtag
results.objective: Log in with username qb and password QuietBench123!, open the Tags menu on the bookmarks page and choose 'Manage tags', then in the tags table click the bookmark count next to the tag 'qbtag', and check that the bookmarks page opens and lists the bookmark 'QB Example' filtered by #qbtag. Then reload the page and verify that the result of the flow is still there.

kane.summary:
The tag count link requests the filtered bookmarks page, but the page response cannot be placed into the part of the tags page that the app tries to update. The app then shows Content missing rather than taking the user to the bookmarks list.
Fix the qbtag bookmark-count link so it performs a full navigation to the filtered bookmarks page, or return the expected page section for the in-page update. Verify that QB Example appears under #qbtag after the link is selected.
evidence: console_error: The response (200) did not contain the expected <turbo-frame id="tag-main"> and will be ignored. To perform a full page 
evidence: objective_contradiction: GET http://localhost:9090/bookmarks?q=%23qbtag -> 200

verdict.root_cause: The tag count link requests the filtered bookmarks page, but the page response cannot be placed into the part of the tags page that the app tries to update. The app then shows Content missing rather than taking the user to the bookmarks list.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the requested path, clicked the bookmark count for the specified qbtag row, and then waited for the expected bookmark. The failed result was caused by the application's navigation/update handling, not by an incorrect agent action.
verdict.bug_title: Tag bookmark-count link fails to load filtered bookmarks
